title: Is social media dead?
reason: 本集从昨日的英语学习与口语焦虑轮换到科技与 AI，讨论生成式 AI 如何改变社交平台及用户行为，贴合软件、平台工程和技术决策背景。所选表达都是原文中可迁移的常用动词搭配，可用于说明技术趋势、用户流失、产品方向和偏好变化，重点训练从看懂到主动调用。

targetExpressions.meaning: as something becomes more common, important or successful
targetExpressions.usage: With the rise of generative AI, online platforms are changing quickly.

targetExpressions.meaning: to make someone lose interest in or stop using something
targetExpressions.usage: Too much low-quality content can turn users away from a platform.

targetExpressions.meaning: to destroy a false belief and reveal an unpleasant reality
targetExpressions.usage: The failed launch shattered the illusion that the product was ready.

targetExpressions.meaning: to actively accept, support or make greater use of something
targetExpressions.usage: Some companies are leaning into AI-generated content.

targetExpressions.meaning: to gradually lose interest in or move away from something
targetExpressions.usage: Users may drift away from services that no longer feel useful.

targetExpressions.meaning: to be naturally attracted or drawn to something
targetExpressions.usage: Developers often gravitate towards tools that are simple and reliable.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete the phrase from the episode: ______ AI, the fun of connecting with friends changed into something stranger.
objectiveQuestions.explanation: The transcript uses “with the rise of AI” to introduce a change that happened as AI became more common.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Which sentence best shows the meaning of “turn someone away from” in the episode?
objectiveQuestions.explanation: The programme says the introduction of AI has made some users lose interest in social media.

options.text: AI-generated content has encouraged everyone to post more.
AI-generated content has made some users stop enjoying or using social media.
AI has taught users how to repair social media.
AI has moved users to a different room.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete Kyle's idea: Angry political debate helped ______ that the internet was always a fun space.
objectiveQuestions.explanation: Kyle says election discourse “shattered the illusion” that the internet was simply a place for fun and friendship.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: What does it mean that tech companies are “leaning into” generated content?
objectiveQuestions.explanation: In context, large social networks are actively embracing and pushing more AI-generated content.

options.text: They are actively making greater use of it.
They are unable to understand it.
They are physically leaning on a computer.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete the prediction: If AI content remains only a novelty, people may ______ it.
objectiveQuestions.explanation: Kyle predicts that users will gradually lose interest in generated content and move away from it.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Complete the phrase: People may ______ smaller online spaces where they can connect with individual voices.
objectiveQuestions.explanation: The transcript says people may be naturally drawn to smaller, more personal online communities.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: Which contrast best matches the episode?
objectiveQuestions.explanation: The episode contrasts large platforms pushing generated content with users wanting more personal and meaningful connections.

options.text: Tech companies lean into generated content, while many users want more personal content.
Users lean into generated content because they dislike personal voices.
Tech companies and users both want less meaningful content.
Smaller communities always create more AI content than large platforms.

objectiveQuestions.prompt: A product team notices users prefer small expert communities to a noisy main feed. Which sentence uses the episode's expression most naturally?
objectiveQuestions.explanation: “Gravitate towards” describes being naturally attracted to an option, so it fits a user preference that develops without force.

options.text: Users gravitate towards smaller expert communities.
Users are gravitated towards smaller expert communities by themselves.
Users gravitate away smaller expert communities.

assessment.retellingPrompt: Without looking at the full transcript, retell the episode in 80-120 words. Use this structure: (1) topic—how AI is changing social media; (2) two key ideas—why some users lost interest and where they may go next; (3) conclusion or a brief product example. Phrase bank: “with the rise of”, “shatter the illusion”, “gravitate towards”. Use at least two phrases naturally. Simple, accurate English is enough; rare vocabulary and complex sentences are not required.
referencePoints: Social media changed from a place for friends and photos into something stranger as AI content increased.
It can be difficult to know whether online content was created by humans or generated by AI.
Social media activity reportedly peaked in 2022 and has declined since then.
Angry political debate in 2015 and 2016 shattered Kyle Chayka's belief that the internet was simply fun and friendly.
Large social networks and powerful technology companies are leaning into generated content, although many users may not want it.
Kyle predicts that people may post less and gravitate towards smaller spaces with more personal, meaningful connections.
